metadata.description: Lani — a language learning game with a Claude Code tutor. Single-plugin marketplace hosting the lani plugin.

plugins.name: lani
plugins.description: Lani — AI Language Learning Kit. Personal AI tutor for any target language (Dutch, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, and more). Uses spaced repetition (SM-2), active recall, adaptive difficulty, and progress tracking across 6 databases. Run /lani-setup to onboard, then /lani-learn, /lani-vocab, /lani-writing, /lani-speaking, /lani-reading, /lani-review daily.
